reviews.title: Scam artists
reviews.text: I have experienced the same scam Sunwing seems to pull on many of its clients. See they offer an early flight for an extra charge and then they cancel the early flight and put everyone on the later one but they never reimburse the cost of the early flight. Many have posted about this scam which Sunwing pulls on people. Also never ever buy from their reps on-site. Twice now I was sold a package fraudulently. Once they sold me a package with 4 sites of which one was snorkeling with turtles. The operator told me they never swim with turtles and Sunwing never reimbursed me. Then they sold me another package with port fees to be paid at the operator. The fee was supposed to be $10 it turned out to be over $100 and had to be paid cash. Again no reimbursement. They only care about making the commission from the sale and then could not care less that what they sold you was not what you got. Be weary of these people.
reviews.author: Rene C

reviews.title: Trip literally Flew By
reviews.text: Flight from Toronto to Cancun and flight back to TO was seemless. Very fast. We even got in early coming back. Too bad we got screened both ways which was odd!!! We did have to make some calls to Sunwing when we noticed our upgraded seats that we had proof of booking ended up going to someone else, but my husband really wanted the priority check-in and priority boarding - good thing he made sure to check status of our seats and called it out. Otherwise a pleasant & fast plane ride both ways.

reviews.title: Horrible customer service and downright scam
reviews.text: Sunwing had 2 flights going to Cancun. One at 11h and one at 9h. It charged and extra $50 for the 9am flight. Then a month before we fly they cancelled the 9am flight but never refunded me the extra $50 they charged for an early flight. So basically they charged a bunch of people an extra $50 and then denied the service and never reimbursed the cost. Then, in cancun, their representative sells us an excursion. It had costs for harbour fees. Now anyone would expect the harbour fees to be per boat at the very least. But the rep assured me this was not so. It was a one cost for the whole group payable at the excursion site. Guess what? Once at the site the operators tell us that the cost is per person. So basically the rep lied to us so we would buy his trip and he can make his cut. Once miles away at the operator we were left to have to deal with an extra $150 cost which had to be paid in cash, no credit card. So I write to Sunwing and it takes them 5 months to send me a form letter that basically tells me they are not responsible for the operators of the excursion and that changes in schedule happen all the time and basically tough crap I’m not getting any customer service. Except it’s not just a change in schedule is it? They charged extra for the earlier flight and the operators are not the ones who lied to me about the price to any were they? Sunwing was responsible for both. This company has gone downhill very fast over that last couple of years. They used to be one of the

reviews.title: DELAYED FOR 15+ HOURS
reviews.text: I was ready to leave my resort at 8am when 15 minutes before my bus picked me up to drop me off at the airport I got a notification from Sunwing that my flight was delayed by a couple of hours. A bit frustrated but no big deal. Then throughout the day I kept getting more emails telling me further on that my flight keeps getting delayed to the point where it’s been almost 15 hours. This is the worst flight experience I have ever had in my entire life. Please please please I AM BEGGING to whoever reads this. Just choose the better slightly more expensive airline. It will be worth it. Under any circumstances do not fly with Sunwing. They will leave you rotting at the airport for 1-2 days And won’t offer ANY compensation unless you FIGHT THEM FOR IT. utterly the worst airline in the entire planet. The seats are too small and crammed, the airplanes don’t look safe, the food on the airplane is horrible. The staff are not nice or welcoming at all. You will be EXTREMELY LUCKY to get your flight on time. This company is known for its super long delays, horrible service, no compensation offered. Overall if you see a vacation package slightly more expensive then Sunwing, jus pay the goddamn money. Trust me you do not wanna go through what Sunwing will put you through. I am here at the airport in Punta cana where some people have been for 2 DAYS waiting for the Sunwing airlines to come take them home. Truly the most disgusting and unprofessional airline of all time. Legit ruined my vacat

reviews.title: Always late, lousy excuses, never pays compensation
reviews.text: I have travelled with sunwing at least a dozen times. Flights are always late. Coming and going. Some of the stewards should not be serving customers due to their attitudes and crankiness. I asked for a water, was told i had to buy a bottle. I didnt take that well. She finally got me a cup of water from 'the sink'. I doubt it was from the sink, more likely from a 2l bottle of water they were making instant coffee from. From the lineup at the airport, to arriving at destination, service was lacking. If you can use any other airline, aside from sunwing, do it. Its the absolute worst.

reviews.title: WORST EXPERIENCE EVER “Don’t do it”
reviews.text: Don’t waste your time or money! My reservation was done and my partner at the time got Covid. I tried to change my plans and was forced to take part of the trip myself, so I don’t lose all my money fast forward to today. I’m trying to change the date on my partners itinerary and no one is willing to help, when you called them and asked to speak to someone because no one can really give you an answer other than what is showing on their screen.. all I wanted to be made clear is the booking date and the travel date so I can make the changes. The lady helping gives me three different answers, when I ask for a supervisor the supervisor or manager is refusing to take the call, w/no reason even if you have a booking with them and confirmation stating that everything was done through them don’t waste your time or money.
reviews.author: Marie

reviews.title: Bag returned within 18 hours!
reviews.text: We had a great experience with Sunwing! Despite all of the poor reviews we personally feel that Sunwing holds themselves accountable if you put in the effort as well. Upon arrival in Toronto, we were assisted through every step of checking in, security, etc. Boarding the plane was smooth and the flight was quick and enjoyable. In Cancun, we experienced some stress as one of our 3 bags did not arrive. Out of everyone on our flight, a total of 3 bags had been lost. Right away we were able to speak to 2 Sunwing representatives in person who helped us fill out a form to get our bag back. The same happened for the other 2 people who had lost their bag. The representatives were kind, helpful, and were adament that the bag would come the next day. The bus from the airport to our hotel had to wait for us and did not leave until we were onboard. Even the representative on the bus was positive that the bag would show up the next day! Keep in mind that our flight landed around 9pm. The next day, we called Toronto about my bag and they informed us that it was currently on a flight to Cancun - the first flight that morning, and that it would arrive at our hotel by that night. Sure enough, the bag arrived that afternoon! So in just 18 hours Sunwing had reunited us with the bag! Of course in the moment we were upset, but we feel that because we put in the work to get updates about the bag, Sunwing was very reassuring and did a fantastic job at getting the bag back to us extremely quickly. W

reviews.title: 2* rating only because of the vacation package provided
reviews.text: We were looking for a last minute vacation deal and Sunwing Vacations offered a deal we could not pass up - if this was the only factor we would give them a 5* review but you need to fly to get there and I rate that a 1*. When we booked the vacation we fully realized that Sunwing AIrlines had become a low cost carrier and very little is included in their flight services - water, tea and coffee that is it. We didn't have a problem with this, the problem arose with the lack of communications that the airline provided. Leaving Calgary the Sunwing communications was great and we received numerous alerts alerting us to the flight status. While in Mexico we received 0 even with the airline having a variety of ways to contact us. When we got to the airport, I checked their app again only to find out that the flight was going to be delayed 50 minutes. This 50 minutes actually turned out to be 90 minutes. At no time did Sunwing airport personnel advise that their was going to be delayed. Our boarding passes still indicated the normal boarding time even though by the time we got checked in I already new that the flight was going to be delayed. Our boarding passes indicate we would be boarding on gate A but there are 9 gates in this section and only got advised of the actual gate about 90 minutes before the flight was to initally depart. The gate agents stood at the gate for well over an hour before they made an announcement that the flight was going to be delayed. Only after we were on

reviews.title: Failure to disclose sanitation difficiency at hotel
reviews.text: Sunwing Vacations knowingly sold and transported us to a hotel that suffered a watermain break. According to the Sunwing rep on site, the watermain break started on Saturday, 3 days before our arrival. Guests resorted to collecting water from the pool to flush their toilets. I suffered from diarrhea on day 2. I asked to be transferred to another hotel or returned to Toronto. My request was refused. Only after threatening to call the Canadian embassy and asking for an emergency evacuation were we transferred to the Grand Mutho Rainbow Hotel. This would not be the hotel of choice for my wife and I but it was far better than the situation that Sunwing placed us in. I submitted a complaint to Sunwing Cares on Feb 24, 2023 and it is now over 95 days since. Sunwing Customer Service has informed me that they have yet to investigate my claim and that it may take another 60 days or longer. Accidents happens! Responsible corporations take ownership and resolve issues such as this because it is the right and ethical thing to do. Apparently Sunwing Vacations are too busy. If you had this experience, would you travel with Sunwing again? Beware, it could happen to you.
reviews.author: Henri L

reviews.title: Stranded in Mexico
reviews.text: We booked Sunwing vacations with hotel transfer from Sunwing. My husband was on a different flight than Sunwing which arrived 10 minutes after our flight. He was at terminal 4 we were at terminal 2. Our Sunwing bus said they could not wait for him to take the airport shuttle and come to our terminal. My husband showed everyone his documentation for the Sunwing bus yet nobody would assist him to get where he needed to go. He called the Rui hotel where we were staying and they did not help him. The taxi services tried to overcharge him and brought him to the bank machine to clean out his account. A lady from a taxi service threatened him that no taxi would take him for less than $150 USD. My husband has a medical condition with a processing disorder. He was at the Cancun airport for 5 hours with everyone refusing to help him My husband said Sunwing did not have his name on their list despite his paperwork. He approached every transfer bus service. Finally he took a taxi for the large price of $100 USD. The Sunwing staff at the hotel are upset that I am not agreeing with them when they try to blame the airport. The representative at the hotel says he doesn’t want to deal with me anymore and told me to speak to someone other than himself to get us back to the airport. I do not feel safe nor supported. We went through emotional trauma and are traumatized , money comes before safety here. Travelling with small child and no way to get back to airport. Will be our last time supportin

Thanks Sunwing.

reviews.title: Ridiculously Horrible Service
reviews.text: 2 hour delayed departure due to plane not being properly staffed. In flight purchase of excursion and told to book the date / time with rep at the hotel. Next morning no rep for orientation. Both myself and wonderful concierge at my resort tried all day to reach this person. Day 3finally got a reply from the CHAT in Sunwing app. That person left during conversation never to reply again and no help. Later that day my travel agent spent over an hour booking the excursion directly with NEXUS as she hot no response from Sinwing rep. 3 of us have called, texted, and left many voice mails by now. In the evening of 3rd day a whatsapp from Aneisha saying basically it looks like my problem got solved (no thanks to her for sure) but no call, no offer of assistance - NO APOLOGY for leaving me in country with no contact. Next day (vacation more than half way over now) I get whatsapp saying WELCOME TO JAMAICA!!!!???? Worst service ever. And it's certainly not the first time, just the first time it's been THIS BAD. I will be trying to avoid SUNWING 🙂
reviews.author: Melanie F

reviews.title: Embarrassing experience
reviews.text: Their online services wouldn't work so nobody could obtain their boarding pass, on top of this their "agent" who was stationed at our resort didn't have a clue; he said "yea, I am sorry, their app frequently doesn't work". At the airport they were the only airline company with a line that was packed with 4 or 5 other flights-worth of people, so things were slow moving. They did not delay any flights and forced the several hundred people to practically sprint through security to get to their flight. It was a logistical nightmare. Luckily nobody in my group was selected for searches, otherwise they would've missed our flight 100%. Being from Canada, especially the east coast, the heat caused a few of our group members to really struggle during the multiple hour wait in the line at the airport – between the heat and mad rush that was required to stay on time, this will be the last time ever I fly with Sunwing Airlines, they simply just don't care about their customers or service, and why should they when their cheaper flights will continue to attract customers trying to save money. One would expect such an airline to at least have a functioning online service and competence to schedule flights in a timely manner. I feel very bad for all of their employees, and all future customers they have.
reviews.author: Justin
